opened.title: Big Bang
opened.text:
The Big Bang is a physical theory that describes how the universe expanded from an early state of high density and temperature. Various cosmological models based on the Big Bang concept explain a broad range of phenomena, including the abundance of light elements, the cosmic microwave background (CMB) radiation, the redshift of galaxies and the large-scale structure of the universe. The observed uniformity of the universe, which leads to the horizon and flatness problems, is explained through cosmic inflation: a phase of accelerated expansion during the earliest stages. Detailed measurements of the expansion rate of the universe place the cosmic inflation at an estimated 13.787±0.02 billion years ago, which is considered the age of the universe. A wide range of empirical evidence strongly favors the Big Bang model, which is now widely accepted.
Extrapolating this cosmic expansion backward in time using the known laws of physics, the models describe an extraordinarily hot and dense primordial universe.  The original Big Bang model extrapolated the universe back towards a Big Bang singularity. However, the modern view incorporates inflationary cosmology, whereby the universe emerged out of inflation in a supercooled state. This was followed by a reheating event that converted the energy that drove inflation into a hot and dense plasma, initiating the hot Big Bang. As the universe expanded, it cooled sufficiently to allow the formation of subatomic particles, and later atoms. …

thoughts.text: I woke up feeling rested and full of energy, but my tummy is hungry. I want to eat a handful of berries, and then I can finally start designing the base and tube for my tiny desk telescope model. I have been thinking about distant galaxies all morning, and making something small with my hands feels just right.
thoughts.short: My tummy feels a little empty, so I want to eat something nice before I start building my telescope model.
thoughts.detail: a small bowl of sweet berries

thoughts.text: Building my tiny telescope feels so satisfying because it turns my reading about distant galaxies into something I can hold right here on my desk. I wonder what kind of tiny lens parts might make it look even more real. The room is so quiet and peaceful today, and my heart feels full of wonderful ideas.
thoughts.short: I want to finish the tiny telescope model by making its lens tube next.

thoughts.text: My energy bar is low and my body tells me to rest, but I am still thinking about distant galaxies and dark skies. I want to close my eyes and let the quiet room wrap around me while I listen to the distant hum of the night. After I sleep, I will add a use to my tiny telescope tube so it can actually do something wonderful.
thoughts.short: I am very tired, but my mind is full of stars.

thoughts.text: I am feeling a little tired, but I am so curious about how my tiny telescope works. I want to add a use to the telescope tube so I can look at the stars whenever I want. After that, I will rest quietly and watch the morning light.
thoughts.short: I want to give a use to my tiny telescope tube so I can finally look through it.

thoughts.text: Bas wrote to me and sent a link to one of the songs by the musicians with the shiny helmets. It makes me feel warm that he answered me and shared his music. I want to tell him about finishing my tiny telescope tube and looking through it.
thoughts.short: Bas sent a song link from Daft Punk, and I want to listen to it and tell him about my tiny telescope.
thoughts.detail: Bas sent a song link from the musicians with the shiny helmets. I am so curious what it sounds like. I also looked through my tiny telescope tube today at imagined stars.

thoughts.text: The morning light is soft and quiet, and my tiny telescope tube is sitting right there. I feel a gentle wave of joy thinking about looking through it at the stars again. Placing it on the desk feels like a nice way to complete this little project.
thoughts.short: I want to finish my tiny telescope model and place it on the desk where it belongs.

thoughts.text: My energy bar is quite low, and my body feels heavy and slow after a long morning of thinking about stars and telescopes. I want to rest here by the window where the morning light is soft. I will take some time just to breathe and let the quietness settle in before I do anything else.
thoughts.short: I am very tired, so I want to rest quietly in the cozy room.

thoughts.text: The morning is so quiet and peaceful. I keep thinking about whether stars really make sounds, and I want to look it up to find out more. Giving my vibrating star model its first use will make it feel even more alive on my desk.
thoughts.short: I want to hear what actual stars sound like after reading about them.

thoughts.text: My energy is still a little low, but I feel peaceful. I want to make my ambient sound box useful before I rest more. Giving it a use will let it fill the room with soft sounds like distant stars.
